_why: Runtime uses of temp files that are not tests (scripts/check-temp-hygiene.js). Each entry says how the file cleans up after itself. Tests, walks and selftests never go here: they use company/tools/lib/temp-life.js.

files.company/tools/lib/temp-life.js: the helper itself: it makes the dirs every test registers, and removes them at exit
files.company/tools/lib/framework-edits.js: diffOf() writes two files to a fresh dir for git diff --no-index and removes it in a finally
files.company/tools/lib/owned.js: reads os.tmpdir() only to know which dirs are temp dirs; makes nothing
files.company/tools/lib/pm-inbox-guard.js: reads os.tmpdir() only to recognise a throwaway test company; makes nothing
files.company/tools/lib/page-preview.js: screenshot() starts one headless Chrome on a fresh profile with TMPDIR inside it, kills it after 45 s at most and removes the profile when Chrome exits
files.company/tools/reaper.js: the reaper reads the temp dirs to clean them (company/tools/tmp-sweep.js rules); it makes nothing there
files.company/tools/station-view.js: the owner's station viewer: its Chrome profile is removed when the viewer ends, and sweepProfiles() removes any a killed viewer left
files.console/connectors.js: the Connect flow's browser shim: a 0700 dir the console removes when the sign-in ends or times out
